certification.name: PECB Certified ISO/IEC 27005 Lead Risk Manager
certification.description: Certification on managing an information security risk management programme based on ISO/IEC 27005, including assessment methods such as OCTAVE, EBIOS and MEHARI. Requires passing the PECB exam plus five years of professional experience, two of them in information security risk management.
certification.currency_note: Exam and certification fees are included in the price of the PECB training course; no standalone list price published
